questions.stem: What is the name of the region in Ladakh where Yangdol and Dorjay live?
questions.solution: The correct answer is Nubra, as it is the specific region where Yangdol and Dorjay live. The other options are either general names of places or constellations, not the particular area referred to in the question.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a planet?
questions.solution: Earth is a planet because it is a celestial body that orbits the Sun and has cleared its orbit of other debris. The Sun is a star, Proxima Centauri is also a star, and the Moon is a natural satellite of Earth, not a planet. Therefore, the correct answer is Earth.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक ग्रह है?
hi.solution: पृथ्वी एक ग्रह है क्योंकि यह सूर्य के चारों ओर घूमने वाला खगोलीय पिंड है और इसके कक्षा से अन्य अपशिष्ट को साफ कर दिया है। सूर्य एक तारा है, प्रॉक्सिमा सेंटौरी भी एक तारा है, और चंद्रमा पृथ्वी का प्राकृतिक उपग्रह है, ग्रह नहीं। इसलिए सही उत्तर पृथ्वी है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English original in meaning, structure, and terminology. All technical terms (ग्रह, खगोलीय पिंड, तारा, उपग्रह) are standard in Hindi science textbooks.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a natural satellite of the Earth?
questions.solution: The Moon is a natural satellite of the Earth, as it orbits the planet naturally without human intervention. Chandrayaan-1 and Vikram Lander are man-made spacecraft, and Halley's Comet is a celestial body that orbits the Sun, not the Earth.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन पृथ्वी का प्राकृतिक उपग्रह है?
hi.solution: चंद्रमा पृथ्वी का प्राकृतिक उपग्रह है, क्योंकि यह मानव हस्तक्षेप के बिना ग्रह के चारों ओर घूमता है। चंद्रयान-1 और विक्रम लैंडर मानव निर्मित अंतरिक्ष यान हैं, और हैली के धूमकेतु एक खगोलीय पिंड है जो सूर्य के चारों ओर घूमता है, पृथ्वी के नहीं।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi terminology as found in standard textbooks.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी भूमीचे प्राकृतिक उपग्रह कोणता आहे?
mr.solution: चंद्र हा भूमीचा प्राकृतिक उपग्रह आहे, कारण तो मानवी हस्तक्षेप शिवाय ग्रहाच्या फेरीत फिरतो. चंद्रायण-१ आणि विक्रम लॅंडर हे मानवनिर्मित अंतरिक्ष यान आहेत, आणि हॅलीचा धूमकेतू हा एक खगोलीय वस्तू आहे जी सूर्याच्या फेरीत फिरते, भूमीच्या फेरीत नाही.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi technical terms.

questions.stem: Which planet is referred to as the Red Planet?
questions.solution: Mars is known as the Red Planet due to its reddish appearance caused by iron oxide on its surface. Venus is often called the Evening Star because it is visible in the evening sky, and Jupiter and Saturn are gas giants, not rocky planets. Therefore, the correct answer is Mars.

hi.stem: कौन सा ग्रह लाल ग्रह के रूप में जाना जाता है?
hi.solution: मंगल को लाल ग्रह के रूप में जाना जाता है क्योंकि इसकी लाल रंगीन दिखाई देने के कारण इसकी सतह पर लौह ऑक्साइड होता है। शुक्र को अक्सर शाम का तारा कहा जाता है क्योंकि यह शाम के आकाश में दिखाई देता है, और बृहस्पति और शनि गैस दानव हैं, चट्टानी ग्रह नहीं। इसलिए सही उत्तर मंगल है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses standard Hindi terms for planets and astronomical concepts.

mr.stem: कोणता ग्रह लाल ग्रह म्हणून ओळखला जातो?
mr.solution: मंगळ लाल ग्रह म्हणून ओळखला जातो कारण त्याच्या सतहीवरील लोह ऑक्साइडमुळे त्याचा लाल रंग असतो. शुक्र रात्रीचा तारा म्हणून ओळखला जातो कारण तो रात्रीच्या आकाशात दिसतो, आणि बृहस्पती आणि शनी वायु दिग्गज आहेत, रॉकी ग्रह नाहीत. म्हणूनच योग्य उत्तर मंगळ आहे.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, with appropriate Marathi terminology used for celestial bodies.

questions.stem: What is the reason behind the Earth being called the Blue Planet?
choices: It is the only planet with water
It reflects blue light from the Sun
questions.solution: The Earth is called the Blue Planet because it appears blue when viewed from space due to the vast amount of water covering its surface. The other options are incorrect because not all planets lack water, the atmosphere is not predominantly blue, and the planet does not reflect blue light from the Sun in a way that would make it appear blue overall.

hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the original English question and solution. All options are correctly translated, and the correct answer remains option (1). The distractors are still incorrect in Hindi, and the technical terms used are appropriate for a Hindi-medium curriculum.

questions.stem: What is the main reason that comets have tails?
choices: They are made of dust and ice that evaporate near the Sun
They are pulled by the gravity of the planets
They reflect sunlight from their surfaces
They are made of metal and rock
questions.solution: Comets have tails because they are composed of dust and ice that vaporize when they get close to the Sun, creating the visible tail. The other options are incorrect because planetary gravity does not cause tails, reflection of sunlight does not explain the tail's formation, and comets are not primarily made of metal and rock.

questions.stem: What would happen if a planet was not revolving around the Sun?
choices: It would no longer be considered a planet
questions.solution: A planet is defined by its orbit around the Sun. If it stopped revolving, it would no longer meet the criteria for being classified as a planet. The other options are not scientifically accurate based on the nature of planetary motion and celestial bodies.

hi.stem: सूर्य के चारों ओर घूमना बंद कर देने पर ग्रह क्या हो जाएगा?
choices: यह अब एक ग्रह माना जाएगा नहीं
hi.solution: एक ग्रह की परिभाषा सूर्य के चारों ओर घूमने के लिए है। यदि यह घूमना बंद कर दे तो यह ग्रह के रूप में वर्गीकृत होने के मानदंड पूरे नहीं करेगा। अन्य विकल्प ग्रहीय गति और खगोलीय पिंडों की प्रकृति के आधार पर वैज्ञानिक रूप से सटीक नहीं हैं।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate scientific terminology in Hindi.

mr.stem: सूर्याच्या फेरीत फिरत नसल्यास ग्रह काय होईल?
mr.solution: ग्रह सूर्याच्या फेरीत फिरत असल्याच्या ओळखीने निश्चित केला जातो. जर तो फिरणे थांबवले तर तो ग्रह म्हणून वर्गीकृत करण्याच्या मापदंडांना अनुरूप राहणार नाही. इतर विकल्प सौर ग्रहांच्या गती आणि खगोलीय वस्तूंच्या प्रकृतीवर आधारित वैज्ञानिकरित्या अचूक नाहीत.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi scientific terminology.

distractorReason: Confuses planets with stars

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct statement about the Moon?
choices: It has water in liquid form
It has no atmosphere or water
It has a lot of vegetation
questions.solution: The correct statement is that the Moon has no atmosphere or water, as these are not present on the Moon's surface. A thick atmosphere and liquid water are not found on the Moon due to its lack of gravitational pull and extreme temperature variations. Vegetation also does not exist there because it requires water, air, and suitable temperatures, which are absent.
